title: Decoding pan-cancer treatment outcomes using multimodal real-world data and explainable artificial intelligence
summary: Explainable AI analyzed multimodal real-world outcomes from 15,726 patients across 38 tumor types and identified disease-context-dependent prognostic patterns. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
